- Total revenue reached £154,660.65 TW, up 6.6% WoW from £145,045.82 LW.
- United Kingdom generated £143,748.77 TW representing 92.9% of total revenue, with orders increasing to 382 TW from 319 LW.
- United Kingdom revenue grew 10.1% WoW, the strongest performance among top three ranked countries.
- Channel Islands achieved £3,401.24 TW revenue TW with a 334.5% WoW increase, ranking second by country.
- EIRE declined to £1,889.68 TW, down 28.4% WoW, representing 1.2% of total revenue.
- France posted the largest WoW increase at 349.8%, reaching £1,271.21 TW from £282.60 LW.
- Switzerland experienced the largest WoW decrease at -82.0%, falling to £1,407.70 TW from £7,802.09 LW.
